name: ListSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. You can call the DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The paging Settings for the number of entries per page in a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页条数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting Settings when querying snapshots.

This parameter must be used together with SortType. Valid values: SnapshotSize and CreatedTime.

A value of SnapshotSize indicates sorting by snapshot size. A value of CreatedTime indicates sorting by creation time.

By default, sorting is in descending order of creation time
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时设置排序方式。

与SortType配合使用，取值必须为SnapshotSize或CreatedTime。

取值为SnapshotSize则根据快照容量排序，取值为CreatedTime则根据创建时间排序。

默认根据创建时间倒序排列
parameters.name: sort_key

parameters.help_en:
The sort order used to query snapshots.

This parameter must be used together with SortKey. Valid values: asc and desc.

A value of asc sorts the snapshots in ascending order. A value of desc sorts the snapshots in descending order.

By default, the snapshots are sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时设置排序方式。

与SortKey配合使用，取值必须为asc或desc。

取值为asc则正序排列，取值为desc则降序排列。

默认根据创建时间倒序排列
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en:
The filter key used to query snapshots.

This parameter must be used together with FilterValue. Valid values: SnapshotId and SnapshotName.

A value of SnapshotId filters the snapshots by snapshot ID. A value of SnapshotName filters the snapshots by snapshot name
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时的筛选键。

与FilterValue配合使用，取值必须为SnapshotId或SnapshotName。

传入SnapshotId则根据快照ID进行筛选，传入SnapshotName则根据快照名称进行筛选
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.help_en:
The filter value used to query snapshots.

This parameter must be used together with FilterKey
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时的筛选值。

与FilterKey配合使用
parameters.name: filter_value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Database File System (DBFS)
parameters.name: fs_id

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot status. Valid values:

progressing: The snapshot is being created.

accomplished: The snapshot was created successfully.

failed: The snapshot failed to be created.

all: All snapshot statuses. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
快照状态。取值范围：

progressing：正在创建的快照。

accomplished：创建成功的快照。

failed：创建失败的快照。

all（默认）：所有快照状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot creation type. Currently, only manual snapshots are supported.
 
user: Manual snapshot.

all: All snapshot creation types. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
快照创建类型。目前仅支持手动快照。
 
user：手动创建快照。

all（默认）：所有的快照创建类型
parameters.name: snapshot_type

parameters.help_en: The snapshot IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照标识编码。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: snapshot_ids

PageSize.description_zh: 输入时设置的每页条数

standard: Standard Edition.

enterprise: Enterprise Edition

SnapshotName.description_en: The display name of the snapshot. This parameter is returned only if a display name was specified when the snapshot was created

progressing
